title: thelypteris isomorpha
intro: Thelypteris isomorpha, commonly known as the isosorus fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the division Pteridophyta, characterized by its leafy fronds. Thelypteris isomorpha has been found to have various health benefits, including its potential to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which can help in the treatment of various diseases such as diabetes, cancer, and bacterial infections. The bioactive constituents of Thelypteris isomorpha include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-inflammatory properties.
